data.name: Branded For Sacrifice
data.detailed_description:
Official Release Date

Branded For Sacrifice will officially be available on 4/23/2026!

The game will include a free PDF Walkthrough Guide in the program files, with details for the MSQ, Optional Content, and all bosses. If you enjoy this game, please also consider checking out Branded For Sacrifice TTRPG, available now on itch.io, or in print on Amazon.

Thank you so much!


About the Game

In Branded For Sacrifice, you play as one of four "Branded" individuals who have been selected as a sacrificial lamb. You awaken in a Mansion whose only other occupant is a strange woman who bids you slay the demons prowling the planet, and bring their Tithe back to her, in exchange for power.

Death is not the end for you, Branded. When you fall in battle, you lose your accumulated Tithe and awaken again in the Mansion. Continue to fight and discover the source of your brand and what the sacrifice really means.

Play as any of the 4 unique characters, and complete optional side quests for unique rewards and secret party members, and experience multiple distinct endings to the game. Experience challenging but winnable turn based combat and bosses in the 5 different dungeons, each with their own strategy to learn. Included in the program files is a PDF Walkthrough with information on the Main Story Quest, Side Quests, and Boss Battles.

All content in this game is created using RPG Maker Event Processing, as an experiment in the capabilities of the program, and does NOT feature any Generative AI or AI assisted content. I hope you enjoy!

data.short_description: Slay demons that plague the world and discover the source of your mysterious brand. A short-form JRPG in the vein of SNES classics, Branded For Sacrifice uses RPG Maker event processing to emulate the Souls'Like Formula.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 8.1/10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL/VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features depictions of fantasy violence, mentions and themes of blood, death, and suicide.

There are also religious themes explored, so please enjoy responsibly.
